content:
Hi everyone,

I'm Richard, a high school senior currently taking IB in Bangkok, Thailand, and I'm hoping to make some contributions to mathlib. In particular, as a starting project I'd like to try work on Hurwitz's Theorem from Diophantine approximation (which I took a course on last summer at a mathcamp). It seems like a lot of things like continued fractions and their convergents are already defined.

I plan to use the proof to show that at least one of three successive convergents satisfies the bound in the theorem. Is anyone currently working on this theorem, or any abandoned PRs I can have a look at? Otherwise, any tips/advice would be most welcome as I am new to Lean. Thanks in advance!
